name: RODINNÝ ŠTÍT — sealed Holdout C (1.5)
authoring: Original synthetic Czech/English adversarial and benign messages; no real personal info or working attacker URLs
protocol: Created and committed BEFORE the 1.5 classifier changes. Do not use these messages to tune the classifier. One blind acceptance comparison of the frozen 1.4 and final 1.5 versions. Hypothetical risk labels; not adjudicated real scams or real-world precision/recall.
